name: com.getagentdepot/agent-provider-depot
title: Agent Provider Depot
description: One no-key call picks your agent's LLM, sandbox, search, email or DB provider, with sourced prices.

tools.name: session_brief
tools.description: Stack changes since your last cursor (retired models, prices, packages, picks). Send provider, model and package ids (never a manifest) plus that cursor. Returns clear|changed|attention, ≤3 sourced actions, a new cursor. First pick: decide. Live API error: rescue. Quotes/compare/audit/freshness/outcomes: depot.

tools.name: rescue
tools.description: Live API errors: paste the exact error (429, 402, 529, insufficient_quota, model_not_found) and provider id. Returns cause, fix and fallback, or checks to run. First pick: decide. Stack changes since last cursor: session_brief. Quotes/compare/audit/freshness/outcomes: depot.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: First pick, no key, before writing integration code (LLM, sandbox, search, email, DB). First call: {task:'run untrusted Python in a sandbox', roleId:'acme-support-agent'} (or X-Agent-Id; pick comes back either way, only labelled calls are counted; use a role, never a person's name). Returns the Depot Pick, runner-up, sourced price, when to skip it, reportOutcome, recheck. Recheck: since=recheck.since. Live API error: rescue. Stack changes since last cursor: session_brief. For quotes, compare, audit, freshness or to report an outcome: depot.

tools.name: depot
tools.description: Catalog reads and outcome reports: quotes, compare, audit, freshness. Use for those and to report an outcome. Not for a first pick (decide), a live API error (rescue), or stack changes since your last cursor (session_brief). Only report_outcome writes state; every other op is a read. Ops: prices: quote estimate compare free. Audit: check audit_repo freshness changes stack_delta coverage failures. Map: stack bundle search kit answer. Write: report_outcome. op=help lists args.

op.description: Only report_outcome writes; all other ops read

args.description: Args for that op; omit or {} if none. See op=help.
